title: ALX Verification Receipt
description: Optional non-Block record of a Graph verification decision, including an explicit record that Graph validation was not performed.
$comment: Applications may create this record after a verification decision. It is not required for core conformance, is not part of Block identity, and does not itself prove validity, authorship, or signature status.

receiptVersion.description: Receipt format version. Must be '1' for v1 receipts.

verifiedAt.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the verification decision was recorded.

verifier.description: Identity of the implementation that produced this receipt.

verification.description: The scoped Graph verification result. checked=false means Graph validation was not requested or performed and status is absent.
